headline: Our problem is not membership, but gaining momentum and a global brand.
ask: Direct the $2.5M projected 2026 surplus into six investment areas for 2027, and vote on two items: the 2027 Tier 2 event portfolio and the ANDxOR end user group charter.

items.label: run agentic AI in production today
say we are moving in the right direction

callout.text: Shipped code: interoperability and conformance testing across the protocols we touch, with published results.

items.label: US-based members.
items.text: The board does not look like the community it governs. 12 companies want to upgrade to Platinum.

items.label: Silver renewals open.
items.text: Silver scores 0 on net recommendation; a member value program must be in market before notices go out.

items.label: Academic members.
items.text: Weakens our talent pipeline and neutral standing.

items.label: Financial services end users, plus 8 telecoms.
items.text: They buy rather than build, and have no forum today.

blocks.title: Six places to invest the $2.5M surplus
blocks.subtitle: Allocations come with the 2027 budget in October

items.question: Are these the right six investment areas?
items.detail: Including a member value program for Gold, Silver and smaller members.

items.question: What belongs in the foundation?
items.detail: Test the scope boundary on two live projects: Open Sandbox and Open Responses.

items.question: Should the board expand?
items.detail: Raise the Platinum cap, add Gold seats, create a Startup Community Committee. No approval sought today.

items.question: Approve the 2027 Tier 2 event portfolio, ~$2.2M?
items.detail: Approving now gets us into 2027 sponsor budget cycles.

items.question: Approve the ANDxOR end user group charter?
items.detail: Gives end users a forum and our projects real production requirements.

footer: Source: foundation operating data and 2026 Member Pulse Survey, September 2026. Exhibits A–E are in the full board pre-read.
